_comment: Choose the entries for the checkpoints you downloaded; delete unused entries. These are three different checkpoints, not three names for the same file. Replace every /PATH/TO path. See README.md for requests.
_comment_voice_dir: Replace /PATH/TO/voice-library with a folder you create. Put narrator.wav and a plain-text prompt_text file in it; see README.md.

models._comment: Base clones a reference voice. Send voice=narrator to read narrator.wav and its transcript from voice_dir.
CustomVoice uses built-in speakers; no reference WAV is needed.
VoiceDesign needs an instruction describing the voice, not a reference WAV.
